output.content:
The saved comparison of glucose (g/L) between **CHO-004-R01** and **CHO-004-R02** (difference = CHO-004-R02 minus CHO-004-R01, exact matched elapsed times, 11 pairs from 0 to 142 h) gives:

- **Mean signed difference: −0.239 g/L** — CHO-004-R02 ran lower than CHO-004-R01 on average.
- **Largest absolute difference: 0.944 g/L at 19.5 h elapsed** — CHO-004-R02 at 6.189 g/L vs CHO-004-R01 at 7.133 g/L.
- Only positive differences were at 0 h (+0.175 g/L) and 28 h (+0.261 g/L); from 44.5 h onward CHO-004-R02 was lower at every matched time. CHO-004-R01 has one extra sample at 164 h (0.124 g/L) with no match in CHO-004-R02, so 11 of 12 samples were compared.

**Provisional status:** these values come from the Northfield Biologics October delivery, which is still in review — values were read from the delivery files and not yet checked (55 open checks), so treat them as unreviewed. The November Northfield runs (CHO-007 through CHO-009) and the Harborview CDMO fed-batch runs (CHO-010 through CHO-012) are also deliveries still in review; none of them were used in this comparison. The result is descriptive only: successive samples of one run are not independent, so no significance test is reported, and product, process version, equipment, scale and stage are not recorded for these batches, so no cause is attributed.
